Round 2 · Implementation · Easy

Ticket #15 — Session Revocation

Difficulty: Easy

Context

You maintain sessions for a member portal. Each login creates a separate session ID for a device. Revocation ends that session's authorization while retaining its record and first logout time. Logging out a phone must leave the same user's laptop session usable.

Practice report

Log in alice as s-1 on a phone and s-2 on a laptop. Call logout("s-1", "10:00"), then check authorization for both IDs.

Observation Current starter Expected
is_authorized("s-1") True False
is_authorized("s-2") True True
Saved s-1.revoked_at "10:00" "10:00"

Acceptance Criteria

  • An existing session is authorized before logout and unauthorized afterward. Unknown session IDs are never authorized.
  • Logout affects only the requested session and persists its first revocation time. A repeated logout succeeds without replacing that time or affecting another device.
  • Logging out an unknown session returns False and creates no record.
  • A duplicate login session ID raises ValueError without replacing the original user or device.

Out of Scope

Use the supplied session IDs and stored time strings. Session expiry, password checks, token cryptography, and a logout-all-devices feature are outside this ticket.

Investigation

Trace login, logout, stored state, and authorization for the two-device report. Add assertions before logout, after logout, and after a repeated logout with a later time. Verify both devices and the original saved revocation time.
